effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] Trash the top 3 cards of your deck. Then, if you have a Tamer, this Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] By returning 3 non Digi-Egg cards from your trash to the bottom of your deck in any order, this Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn.
